q: I bark to say hello, wag my tail when I'm happy, and love to fetch a ball. What am I?
I purr when I'm happy, chase after mice, and love to nap in sunny spots. What am I?
I live on a farm, say 'moo,' and give milk every day. What am I?
I waddle on land, swim in ponds, and say 'quack.' What am I?
I have a golden mane, I'm called the king of the jungle, and I roar loudly. What am I?
I have a long trunk, huge floppy ears, and I'm the biggest animal that walks on land. What am I?
I live underwater, breathe through gills, and swim using my fins. What am I?
I can be taught to copy the words you say, and I have bright, colorful feathers. What am I?
I buzz from flower to flower, make honey in my hive, and can give you a sting. What am I?
I hop instead of walk, start life as a tadpole, and love sitting on lily pads. What am I?
I have long ears, a fluffy tail, and I hop around nibbling carrots. What am I?
I start out as a caterpillar, wrap myself in a cocoon, and come out with colorful wings. What am I?
I grow soft, curly wool, live in a flock, and say 'baa.' What am I?
I have a flowing mane, gallop across fields, and people can ride on my back. What am I?
I lay eggs every morning, scratch at the ground, and say 'cluck.' What am I?
I have no legs at all, slither along the ground, and flick my tongue to smell the air. What am I?
I carry my hard shell wherever I go, and I move very slowly. What am I?
I have thick fur, love honey, and sleep all winter long. What am I?
I swing from branch to branch, love bananas, and can climb trees quickly. What am I?
I roll in the mud to stay cool, live on a farm, and say 'oink.' What am I?
I'm round and crunchy, can be red or green, and grow on trees. What am I?
I'm yellow and curved, easy to peel, and monkeys love to eat me. What am I?
I'm a white drink that comes from a cow, and I help make your bones strong. What am I?
I'm made from flour and baked in an oven, and you can use two slices of me to make a sandwich. What am I?
I have a hard shell on the outside, and a yolk and white on the inside. What am I?
I'm cold and sweet, come in many flavors, and melt quickly in the sun. What am I?
I'm made by bees, sticky and sweet, and stored in a hive. What am I?
I'm green on the outside, pink on the inside, and full of little black seeds. What am I?
I'm long and orange, I grow underground, and rabbits love to munch on me. What am I?
I'm round, orange, and juicy, and you peel me before eating my slices. What am I?
I'm baked in an oven, often have chocolate chips, and am a favorite sweet snack. What am I?
I start as a hard little kernel, then pop into a fluffy white snack when heated. What am I?
I grow in bunches on a vine, and I'm small, round, and juicy. What am I?
I'm red with tiny seeds on the outside, and shaped a bit like a heart. What am I?
I'm made from milk, come in many shapes, and mice are said to love me. What am I?
I shine in the sky during the day, give you warmth, and light up the whole world. What am I?
I fall from clouds in little drops, help flowers grow, and make puddles on the ground. What am I?
I fall softly from the sky in winter, I'm cold and white, and you can build a man out of me. What am I?
I float high in the sky, I'm soft and puffy looking, and sometimes I bring rain. What am I?
I appear in the sky after it rains, and I'm made of many colors in an arch. What am I?
You can't see me, but you can feel me blow, and I can make the leaves dance and kites fly. What am I?
I glow in the night sky, change shape through the month, and circle the Earth. What am I?
I twinkle high in the night sky, and there are millions of me. What am I?
I have a trunk, branches, and leaves, and birds like to build nests in me. What am I?
I grow from a seed, have colorful petals, and bees like to visit me. What am I?
I grow on trees, I'm usually green, and I turn orange and fall in autumn. What am I?
I flow from the mountains to the sea, and fish love to swim in me. What am I?
I'm very tall and rocky, sometimes covered in snow at the top, and hard to climb. What am I?
I'm a huge body of salty water, home to whales and fish, and cover most of the Earth. What am I?
I form on the ground after it rains, and I'm small enough to jump over. What am I?
